_comment: OPT-IN, DEV-ONLY harness manifest. This is NOT part of the extension and
nothing here ever reaches a store zip: scripts/store-build.mjs stages only
background/, content/, popup/, shared/ and icons/, so tests/ cannot ship.
It is nested on purpose. The ROOT package.json must keep declaring zero
dependencies and zero devDependencies — ci.yml::lint-js has a tripwire
('no JS deps in package.json') that fails the build otherwise, and a second
one that fails if the root package-lock.json resolves any third-party
package. Putting the harness dependency here keeps both true, and keeps the
README's 'zero runtime dependencies' badge honest, because a developer who
never runs `npm run smoke` never installs any of this.
Install is manual and deliberate:  npm --prefix tests/smoke install
Nothing installs it for you: there is no postinstall hook and the root
`prepare` script does not reach in here.
node_modules/ and package-lock.json under this directory are gitignored.
The lockfile in particular is NOT committed: .github/workflows/
dependency-review.yml runs on every PR with fail-on-severity: moderate,
and a committed lockfile would put puppeteer's whole transitive closure
into the dependency graph, where any unrelated advisory could turn a PR
red for a package that never ships. The single exact-pinned devDependency
below is the smallest surface that still lets `npm --prefix tests/smoke
install` do the right thing. Bumping it is a one-line edit here.
name: locke-extension-smoke
description: Developer-run, in-browser smoke harness for the Locke extension. Not run in CI.
